title: Parse review queue
lead: Admin queue to confirm or correct low-confidence parses and matches; each answer is cached forever (I5).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Rules won't cover everything. Confirming a line once means the same line never needs reviewing again, so the review workload trends toward zero.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Queue placement: an admin page with a count badge (recommended)?
2. Confirm in bulk (one tap per line) vs. a full edit form per line?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Query unresolved lines; show the raw text, parsed fields and a candidate item.
2. Actions: confirm, edit fields, choose a different item, create an item, mark as non-food.
3. Persist `parse_override` keyed by the normalized raw text, plus an `item_alias`.
4. Re-apply overrides during indexing.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Review tests pass; clearing the queue for the imported recipes takes the owner a few minutes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
